scope: Targeted UI review of the current Atlas entry and Lab; preference branching is covered by language-preference-tests.mjs.
checks: Lab manual English survives a fresh visit without a language query.
English selection is shared from Lab to Atlas.
Atlas manual Japanese is shared back to Lab.
Atlas French survives reload and a fresh visit without a query; its selector and translated body agree.
Lab uses English for the saved unsupported French choice.
Stable Lab redirect preserves ?lang=ja and #result; explicit query overrides saved choice.
Japanese and English Lab results still display the verified change quotient 6 + epsilon.
limits: Browser preference variants and denied-storage paths are verified in Node with injected values, not by changing the browser profile.
This review does not certify every UI feature or mathematical theorem.
